name: Gegemoon 9D Teeth Whitening Strips | Professional Teeth Whitening Kit | Enamel Safe Whitening Strips | Deep Stain Removal | Mint Flavor | 7 Pairs
description:
Get a brighter, more confident smile with Gegemoon 9D Teeth Whitening Strips. Featuring an advanced whitening formula, these professional strips penetrate deep into tooth enamel to help reduce stains caused by coffee, tea, tobacco, wine, and everyday foods. The flexible strips comfortably fit both upper and lower teeth, ensuring secure adhesion for effective whitening while remaining gentle on enamel. With an easy 30-minute application and refreshing mint flavor, this convenient whitening kit helps you achieve a cleaner, brighter smile from the comfort of your home.

Key Features
Advanced 9D teeth whitening technology
Helps remove deep stains from coffee, tea, tobacco, and wine
Penetrates enamel for effective whitening
Enamel-safe and gentle formula
Flexible strips fit both upper and lower teeth
Secure adhesive for comfortable application
Refreshing mint flavor for a clean feeling
Easy 30-minute daily treatment
Comfortable, mess-free peel-and-apply design
Suitable for home teeth whitening routine

Product Specifications
Brand: Gegemoon
Product Type: Teeth Whitening Strips
Quantity: 7 Pairs (14 Strips)
Net Weight: 2.5g (Approx.)
Flavor: Mint
Technology: 9D Whitening

How to Use
Brush and dry your teeth before application
Open the foil pouch with dry hands
Peel the strips from the backing liner
Apply the lower strip with the gel side against your teeth
Align with the gum line and press gently to secure
Fold the remaining strip behind the teeth
Repeat with the upper strip
Leave on for approximately 30 minutes
Remove and discard the strips after use
Rinse your mouth thoroughly

Safety Information
For oral use only
Do not swallow the strips
Not suitable for children under 12 years of age
Not recommended for pregnant women
Do not use on irritated gums or mouth ulcers
Avoid contact with eyes
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
